description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. New global download manager panel: real-time download speed display, and mod prerequisite dependencies can be downloaded with one tap.
2. Added disk caching for remote mod query results (fingerprints/details/version lists/categories), now backed by SQLite, reducing repeated network requests; CurseForge fingerprints of large files are now computed in a streaming fashion to avoid OOM, and Modrinth 404 misses are negatively cached to eliminate repeated futile lookups.
3. Modpack installation now reports real-time progress during unzip and parse stages; the task dialog log area auto-collapses when the logging task finishes; version list refresh tasks now show their names so the wait is visible while installing loaders.
4. Controller layouts are lazily loaded, speeding up loading.
5. Downloads now wait with exponential backoff between retries, and the connection timeout is raised to 10 seconds.
6. MenuView rewritten in Kotlin with improved touch-open drawer detection.
7. Fixed the offline skin dialog overwriting the old skin file when cancelled; the skin file is only written on confirm.
8. Fixed freezing on some devices while dragging the theme color picker (theme refresh messages are now merged).
9. Fixed a crash on NeoForge version lists with missing fields and a controller edit-mode view group initialization timing issue.
10. Mod data classes record-ized and migrated to kotlinx.serialization, eliminating missing-field NPEs at the root.
11. Updated MioLibPatcher; upgraded the toolchain to Kotlin 2.4.10 and Gradle 8.14.4, fixing a dex metadata parsing crash.
12. Updated translations.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增全局下载管理面板：标题行实时显示下载速度，模组前置依赖支持一键下载
2.新增模组远程查询结果磁盘缓存（指纹/详情/版本列表/分类），存储改用 SQLite，减少重复网络请求；CurseForge 大文件指纹改流式计算避免 OOM，Modrinth 未命中写入负缓存消除重复白查
3.整合包安装解压与解析阶段上报实时进度，任务对话框日志区在任务结束后自动收起；版本列表刷新任务显示名称，安装加载器期间等待可见
4.懒加载控制布局，优化加载速度
5.下载重试间增加指数退避等待，连接超时调整为 10 秒
6.MenuView 重写为 Kotlin，优化触摸打开抽屉判定
7.修复离线皮肤对话框取消时覆盖旧皮肤文件，确认时才落位
8.修复取色拖动时部分设备卡死（主题刷新消息合并）
9.修复 NeoForge 版本列表缺失字段崩溃与控制器编辑模式视图组初始化时序问题
10.模组数据类 record 化并迁移 kotlinx.serialization，根治缺失字段 NPE
11.更新 MioLibPatcher，升级 Kotlin 2.4.10 与 Gradle 8.14.4 工具链并修复 dex metadata 解析崩溃
12.更新多语言翻译
